meta.name: Palantir
meta.description: Palantir Technologies' authentic visual identity, derived from a FULL read of the primary corpus: all IR/investor decks across 2022–2025 (~330 slides), 6 whitepapers/service-definition docs (66pp), the Airbus partnership deck, and the live palantir.com 'Warp Speed' capture — not downstream replicas. Core DNA: a neo-grotesque (Neue Haas Grotesk / Univers-class) typeface at REGULAR–MEDIUM weight (never bold) with tabular numerals and ink-color underline emphasis — NOT a system font; STRICTLY MONOCHROME charts (color only in photos and embedded product UI); a monochrome charcoal/white base with light↔dark INVERSION as a device; and a SINGLE SURGICAL ACCENT whose HUE VARIES BY ERA/CAMPAIGN (2022 none, 2024 AIP purple #7C3AED, 2025 emerald #00E599 + cyan #35C6E6) — always 1–2 instances, never a solid fill, never inside a chart. Corner radius and accent are register/era-conditional, not brand constants: sharp square print/formal base; softened corners and era accent only on IR/marketing screen surfaces. 多元 fixes emerald #00E599 as its single accent.
source_references: PRIMARY (FULL READ) — Palantir IR/investor decks: Q1'22, Q2'22 (accent = NONE, pure monochrome); Q2'24, Q3'24, Q4'24 (AIP-era purple #7C3AED, gradient #C026D3→#4F46E5); Q1'25, Q3'25, Q4'25 (emerald #00E599 + cyan #35C6E6 delta) — ~330 slides total. Register: warm-grey #D8D8D8 stage, charcoal #1C2127 panels (16–26px), stadium pills, strictly-monochrome bar charts (hollow prior / solid-or-gradient current, dotted +NN% connectors, dashed halo, '//' axis-break), light↔dark inversion

PRIMARY — 6 whitepapers / service-definition docs (66pp) incl. Palantir Platform: Gotham 'Service Definition Document' (G-Cloud 14) A4 procurement doc. Register: formal/print — background white or warm cream #F2EFE6, pure-black body, color allowed only in photos/diagrams/links/headings (muted blue), narrow left rail + wide body, mandatory decimal numbering, dotted-leader TOC, running header/footer, grayscale facet cover photo
PRIMARY — Palantir & Airbus Partnership Overview deck (register: marketing/partnership; co-brand lockup 'Palantir • Airbus' — partner logo keeps own color, Palantir monochrome)

PRIMARY — AmCham Italy 'Palantir AIP Overview' 16:9 company deck (dual-mode dark cover/dividers + light content; sharp ~0-4px corners; monochrome). NOTE: corner registration brackets ⌐ and ±tick strips are SPECIFIC TO THIS marketing deck and NOT present in the IR decks — Drive: デザインシステム/presentations/Whitepapers/AmCham_Italy_Palantir.pdf

PRIMARY — https://www.palantir.com and /jp LIVE 'Warp Speed' capture (dark charcoal video heroes, 'Scroll to Explore', neo-grotesque display, sparing emerald accent, near-sharp 2–6px UI corners; CTAs 'Request a Demo →' / 'デモの申込はこちら')

PRIMARY — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/palantir/blueprint/develop/packages/colors/src/colors.ts (authoritative surface ramp: BLACK #111418, DARK_GRAY1-5 #1C2127/#252A31/#2F343C/#383E47/#404854, GRAY1-5 #5F6B7C→#C5CBD3, LIGHT_GRAY1-5 #D3D8DE→#F6F7F9)
DOWNSTREAM / degraded — ~/Developer/plural-reality/palantir/ (写経 replica): system font (-apple-system), invented #00FF00 terminal-green, generic Tailwind grays. Diff evidence only.

DOWNSTREAM / degraded — ~/Desktop/plural-reality/plural-reality-design-preview.html + plural-reality-design-system/SKILL.md (多元 adaptation: Teal #0F766E/#2DD4BF + Public Sans — 多元's own brand choices, NOT Palantir DNA)

primary.role: Primary ink and dominant inverted surface — black text on light, full-bleed near-black (#0E0E10–#141418) background on dark sections, solid button fill

secondary.role: Primary canvas and inverted foreground — page background on light, text/UI on dark sections

accent.role: SINGLE SURGICAL ACCENT whose HUE VARIES BY CAMPAIGN/ERA — it is NOT a fixed brand constant. 2022 IR decks (Q1'22/Q2'22) = NONE, pure monochrome charcoal/white. 2024 AIP-era decks (Q2'24/Q3'24/Q4'24) = purple #7C3AED, applied as a gradient #C026D3→#4F46E5. 2025 decks (Q1'25/Q3'25/Q4'25) + live warpspeed = emerald #00E599 (2-value scale: neon self #00E599 / muted peer #1F9E6E) plus a SECONDARY cyan #35C6E6 (delta / prior-quarter marker). In every era the accent appears in only 1–2 instances per surface, NEVER as a solid fill, and NEVER inside native charts (charts stay strictly monochrome; color lives only in photos and embedded product UI). UI/link weight of emerald ≈ #00C868–#21C77A. 多元 FIXES emerald #00E599 as its single accent. Degradation markers (NOT Palantir): teal #2DD4BF / #0F766E (多元's own web choice), and #00FF00 terminal-green (写経 replica invention).

neutral.usage: Authoritative Blueprint grayscale. BLACK #111418 + DARK_GRAY1-5 (#1C2127→#404854) = dark charcoal surfaces/cards/borders on inverted & hero sections; GRAY1-5 (#5F6B7C→#C5CBD3) = muted body/caption/icon text and mid rules; LIGHT_GRAY1-5 (#D3D8DE→#F6F7F9) = hairline borders and near-white content fills. IR register adds a warm-grey stage #D8D8D8.

color.contrast_strategy: high contrast, achromatic, and INVERSION-AS-DEVICE. Dark IR stage background ranges near-black #0E0E10–#1C2127 (2025 decks warm it slightly to #1A1D22); light register uses a warm-grey stage #D8D8D8 with light cards #EFEFEF / #C7C7C7 and pure-black text. The signature move is LIGHT↔DARK INVERSION: a dark panel with white bars/type is mirrored by a light card with black bars/type — the same chart or KPI block flips polarity to separate sections or contrast this-quarter vs prior. Registers: (1) light content = warm-grey #D8D8D8 stage / #EFEFEF–#C7C7C7 cards / black text; (2) dark hero & dividers = near-black #0E0E10–#1C2127 with white display type; (3) IR panels = charcoal #1C2127 secondary #252A31, border #383E47. No gradients (except the era-specific AIP purple accent gradient), no tinted mid-tones.

font_families.heading: Neue Haas Grotesk / Univers-class neo-grotesque (real neo-grotesque, NOT a system font): even stroke, single-story a, open apertures, near-circular O; used large with tight negative tracking at regular–medium weight. Web tier substitutes 'Geist'. JP pairing for 多元: Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN / Zen Kaku Gothic New. Fallback: 'Neue Haas Grotesk Display', 'Geist', Univers, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
font_families.body: Same neo-grotesque family at regular weight (web tier 'Geist'); JP body Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN / Zen Kaku Gothic New for 多元; fallback 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
font_families.mono: SF Mono, ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace — reserved for tiny uppercase micro-labels, footer metadata, and monospaced/tabular numerals in stat blocks and chart legends

typography.font_style_notes: Neo-grotesque (Neue Haas Grotesk / Univers-class), NOT a proprietary or system face: constructed letterforms, single-story a, open apertures, optimized for legibility at small sizes on dense dashboards and slides. Weight stays REGULAR–MEDIUM (never bold) — hierarchy comes from scale and negative tracking, not weight; body neutral regular at 1.6. Numerals are TABULAR / MONOSPACED so KPI columns and prior-vs-current deltas align. EMPHASIS = INK-COLOR UNDERLINE ONLY (an underline in the current text color), never a colored word. Signature devices: (1) ink-underline-as-emphasis on key phrases in headlines; (2) tabular numerals for stat blocks / KPIs / page pips / chart axes; (3) tiny UPPERCASE MONO micro-labels for section/category tags and footer metadata. NOT a system font stack — the -apple-system fallback in the 写経 replica is a degradation.

spacing.base_unit: 8px rhythm (4px sub-steps); very large hero/section spacing on a ~100px scale
spacing.section_rhythm: Section padding escalates 64 → 96 → 128px responsive, up to 200–400px on hero/marquee bands; alternating light and inverted (near-black/charcoal) full-viewport sections create a strong breathing cadence

layout.grid_system: 12-column responsive grid; card grids 3–4 cols, feature/split at 7:5 or 1:1; case studies as asymmetric bento/mosaic
layout.max_content_width: 1280–1440px centered container (screen); A4 portrait for formal/print register
layout.alignment_tendency: strict grid, left-aligned copy; centered CTA moments. PRINT/FORMAL register uses a distinctive skeleton: a narrow LEFT RAIL (28–32%, small-caps grey section labels) beside a wide RIGHT BODY, separated and sequenced by hairline rules; text justified; running header/footer; mandatory decimal section numbering; dotted-leader TOC (legal/service-def) or hairline+two-tone-number TOC (narrative)

shape.border_usage: REGISTER-CONDITIONAL — sharp base, softened only on IR/marketing screen surfaces. By register: cover/divider panels 24–32px; financial/data panels 16–26px; pill tags = stadium (9999px / full); live web UI (buttons/cards) 2–6px near-sharp; print/formal (service-def A4) 0px square, photos only 4–6px. Borders are 1px hairlines (LIGHT_GRAY #E5E8EB on light, DARK_GRAY4 #383E47 on dark) and are the primary structural device in place of shadow.
shape.divider_style: 1px solid hairline; full-width section separators, card top-borders, masthead/footer rules; hover promotes border color toward foreground

levels.high: 0 10px 25px rgba(17,20,24,0.10) — rare card-hover maximum; IR register uses soft studio shadow under matte-3D glyph

elevation.depth_cues: overlapping layers, 1px borders, inverted full-bleed color bands, and matte-3D isometric renders; depth via color intensity and studio lighting, not glass/blur

iconography.style: outline / line icons, geometric and minimal, single-color currentColor; plus engineering/blueprint marks
iconography.preferred_set: Minimal inline SVG chevrons/arrows (trailing → on CTAs; ↳ sub-bullets); product surfaces use Blueprint Icons (open-source Palantir set); decks add stadium/segmented pill tags, page-progress pips (●○○○), breadcrumb, dashed diagonal connectors, and matte isometric 3-D glyphs. NOTE: corner registration brackets (⌐) and ±tick strips are AmCham-marketing-deck-specific and are NOT present in the IR decks.

motion.entrance_pattern: fade-in + ~20px upward translate on scroll-enter, block-level stagger ~100ms; hero 'Scroll to Explore' linear reveal; looping hero video
motion.exit_pattern: simple opacity/color fade, no directional exit
motion.philosophy: minimal functional — video loops, fade/scroll-reveal, black↔white hover inversion, subtle image scale (1.05), border-color promotion; no decorative or continuous animation, no particles/3D-scene/shader/glass

components.button_style: Sharp-to-slightly-rounded rectangle (register: 0–6px). Primary = solid black/#111418 fill, white text. Secondary/ghost = transparent, black text + 1px black border, hover inverts to black fill + white text. ~48px tall, medium (500), 14–16px, trailing → on CTAs. IR register may use emerald-filled or pill CTAs.
components.input_style: Sharp rectangle, 1px solid border, no inner shadow; rare on marketing surfaces
components.card_style: Charcoal (#1C2127) on dark or near-white on light, 1px hairline border (often top-border only), radius per register (0–4px overview/formal, 2–6px web, 20–24px IR panels), no resting shadow; hover raises subtle shadow and scales contained image 1.05
components.navigation_pattern: Fixed/sticky top bar ~64px, 1px bottom border, bold wordmark + Q mark left, small muted text links right; formal docs use running header (product + Gotham logo + Q) and footer (page no. + confidentiality)
components.modal_style: Sharp high-contrast panel, 1px border, dimmed backdrop (no glass)
components.list_style: Border-separated rows / top-border cards; arrow bullets (→ / ↳); em-dash '——' lead-ins; MANDATORY NUMBERING in formal register (decimal sections '1.0', '01–' lists). TOC style splits by register: dotted-leader TOC for legal/service-def docs; hairline-rule + two-tone-number TOC for narrative decks.
components.component_notes: Everything rectangular and border-defined; signature interaction = button/border black↔white inversion on hover. CHARTS ARE STRICTLY MONOCHROME — no red/blue/green in any native chart; the only color on the page lives in photos and embedded product-UI screenshots. Chart signature: prior-period = HOLLOW OUTLINE bar; current-period = SOLID white/black bar OR a white→grey gradient bar; dotted diagonal '+NN%' connectors link the two; a DASHED HALO RING marks the latest data point; axis discontinuities use an axis-break '//'; legends are mono UPPERCASE. Page-progress pips (●○○○) double as literal dot-matrix data counts. ORNAMENT component language: stadium/segmented pill tags ([Q4│Business Update]), tiny uppercase mono micro-labels, hairline MULTI-BAND footers, dashed connectors, breadcrumb, and matte isometric 3-D glyphs rendered with soft studio light. Oversized tabular KPI numerals (regular–medium, never bold) act as standalone components. NOTE: corner registration brackets (⌐) and ±tick strips are AmCham-marketing-deck-specific, NOT present in IR decks.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: command console / precision instrument — a charcoal-and-white operating surface where data, typography, and blueprint marks are the only ornament
aesthetic.era_influence: Swiss International Typographic Style meets contemporary defense/enterprise console and technical-blueprint aesthetics
aesthetic.genre: enterprise / government & defense B2B, high-trust deep-tech

visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous — large section padding (up to 300–400px), constrained measure, one message per section
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: heavy typography and full-bleed inverted/video sections anchor the page; imagery, thin borders, and blueprint marks stay recessive
visual_language.focal_strategy: single hero element per section — a bold headline or oversized tabular KPI numeral carries each viewport
visual_language.contrast_level: very high (charcoal/black on white, and inverted)
visual_language.texture_usage: flat — no gradients/noise (except the era-specific AIP purple accent gradient #C026D3→#4F46E5); monochrome high-contrast photography, looping video, matte-3D isometric renders. ORNAMENT supplies the only 'texture': stadium/segmented pill tags, tiny uppercase mono micro-labels, hairline multi-band footers, dashed diagonal connectors, page-progress pips (●○○) doubling as dot-matrix data counts, and grayscale folded-paper facet cover imagery. (Corner brackets ⌐ and ±tick strips are AmCham-deck-specific, not IR.)

composition.hierarchy_method: scale contrast + spatial isolation (huge bold headings and tabular KPI numerals isolated in whitespace), reinforced by typographic weight and underline-as-emphasis
composition.balance_type: asymmetric (left-aligned copy on strict grid; bento/mosaic case grids) with symmetric centered CTA moments
composition.flow_direction: top-to-bottom vertical narrative, alternating light/inverted bands; 'Scroll to Explore' linear reveal
composition.grouping_strategy: 1px borders, grid gutters, and hairline-ruled footers group content; numbered steps and dotted-leader TOC sequence formal docs
composition.negative_space_role: structural and expressive — whitespace is the primary compositional material, signaling confidence and clarity

imagery.photo_treatment: high-contrast, low-saturation, near-monochrome documentary/product imagery; grayscale folded-paper facet abstractions; looping product-reel video; 16:9 / 4:3 crops, object-cover
imagery.illustration_style: essentially none — favors real product UI, matte-3D isometric glyph renders, abstract data/tech footage
imagery.graphic_elements: hairline rules and multi-band footers, oversized tabular numerals, monochrome bar charts (hollow-outline prior / solid or gradient current, dotted +NN% connectors, dashed halo ring, '//' axis-break), thin arrow/chevron SVGs (→ / ↳), stadium pill tags, page pips (also dot-matrix counts), rectangular frames, matte isometric 3-D glyphs (corner brackets ⌐ / ±tick strips only in AmCham marketing decks)
imagery.pattern_usage: none (blueprint marks are structural, not decorative pattern)
imagery.image_shape: hard rectangles, no rounded corners on media, full-bleed or grid-clipped

interaction_feel.feedback_style: subtle and immediate — color/border inversion and mild shadow lift on hover
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: buttons invert fill/text; cards raise shadow and scale image 1.05; links underline / turn emerald; borders promote toward foreground
interaction_feel.transition_personality: fade-subtle / snappy — 200–300ms ease-out color and opacity, nothing bouncy
interaction_feel.loading_style: minimal — simple fade-in with static poster frames behind hero video
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: low — a small, deliberate set of interactions, no ambient motion

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: confident, technical, understated authority; lets data, outcomes, and mission gravity speak
brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: direct imperative — 'Request a Demo →' / 'Start Building →' / 'デモの申込はこちら', trailing arrow
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: sparse and factual — plain statement, no illustration or playful copy

overview.fallback_strategy: reduce to CSS / static snapshot — hero video degrades to a static poster frame; scroll-reveal respects prefers-reduced-motion
overview.primary_technology: CSS transitions + keyframes with autoplay/muted/looping <video> backgrounds; NO WebGL/Canvas/particles/shaders

background_effects.description: Live palantir.com heroes use full-bleed autoplay/muted/loop product-reel videos over near-black charcoal (#0E0E10–#141418), dimmed. Non-video sections are flat solid black/white/charcoal or warm-grey (#D8D8D8) IR stage — no gradients or generative art.
background_effects.technology: HTML5 <video autoplay muted loop playsinline> with object-cover + darkening overlay

params.opacity: ~0.4 video with dark overlay; solid for non-video sections
params.blend_mode: normal (darkened via opacity/overlay, no blend mode)

particle_systems.description: No particle systems. Palantir's restraint precludes floating dots, confetti, or connected-node fields.

3d_elements.description: No real-time WebGL/Three.js 3D scenes. The matte-black isometric extruded glyph in decks/hero is a pre-rendered raster image with soft studio lighting, not an interactive 3D scene.

scroll_triggered_animations.animation_type: fade-up (opacity 0→1 + ~20px translateY), block-level stagger; oversized KPI numerals may reveal/count on enter
scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: triggered (play once on enter), not scrubbed

scroll_morphing.description: No scroll-linked geometry morphing. Live site uses a linear 'Scroll to Explore' narrative with discrete reveals.

text_effects.description: No split-letter, glitch, gradient-fill, or 3D-extrude text effects. Emphasis is pure scale, tight negative tracking, and ink-color underline-as-emphasis (weight stays regular–medium, never bold). Only text motion is the shared fade-up entrance reveal.

cursor_effects.description: Default system cursor; no custom cursor, magnetic buttons, spotlight, or trail.

image_effects.description: Restrained: card images scale 1.05 on hover inside a fixed overflow-hidden frame (~300ms); images/sections fade-up on scroll-enter. Photography treated toward monochrome/high-contrast. No RGB-shift, tilt, or distortion.
image_effects.technology: CSS transform + transition, overflow-hidden clip frame, IntersectionObserver reveal

canvas_drawings.description: No Canvas 2D generative art or interactive drawing on brand surfaces. Data shown as typography/KPIs, video, and product screenshots.

svg_animations.description: SVG used statically for arrow/chevron icons and blueprint marks; no path-draw, morph, or stroke animation.

visual_effects.composite_notes: REGISTER-CONDITIONAL + ERA-VARIABLE model is the master rule (this reflects a FULL read of all IR decks 2022–2025 plus whitepapers/service-def, Airbus, and live warpspeed). Shared brand core across every register and era: neo-grotesque (Neue Haas Grotesk / Univers-class) type at regular–medium weight with tabular numerals and ink-color underline emphasis, monochrome charcoal/white base, 1px hairline borders, minimal-functional motion, and STRICTLY MONOCHROME CHARTS (no red/blue/green natively — color lives only in photos and embedded product UI). Chart signature: hollow-outline prior bar, solid or white→grey-gradient current bar, dotted diagonal +NN% connectors, dashed halo ring on the latest point, '//' axis-break, mono uppercase legends. Ornament: stadium/segmented pill tags, mono micro-labels, hairline multi-band footers, dashed connectors, breadcrumb, page pips (also dot-matrix data counts), matte isometric 3-D glyphs — corner brackets ⌐ / ±tick strips are AmCham-deck-specific, NOT IR. LIGHT↔DARK INVERSION is a deliberate device (dark panel + white bars ⇔ light card + black bars). ACCENT IS ERA/CAMPAIGN-VARIABLE, never a fixed constant, always 1–2 instances, never a solid fill, never inside a chart: 2022 = none (pure monochrome); 2024 AIP-era = purple #7C3AED gradient #C026D3→#4F46E5; 2025 + live = emerald #00E599 (2-value: neon #00E599 / muted #1F9E6E) + secondary cyan #35C6E6 for deltas. 多元 fixes emerald #00E599 as its single accent. Register variance: (A) SCREEN / IR / MARKETING — softened corners (live UI 2–6px, financial panels 16–26px, cover/divider 24–32px, stadium pills), era accent, warm-grey #D8D8D8 stage (light cards #EFEFEF/#C7C7C7) or near-black #0E0E10–#1C2127 (2025 warmer #1A1D22) video/data heroes; (B) PRINT / FORMAL (service-def A4, company-overview deck) — 0px square corners (photos 4–6px), background WHITE or warm cream #F2EFE6, body text PURE BLACK monochrome, BUT color IS allowed in photos/diagrams/links and (whitepaper) headings (e.g. muted blue), narrow left rail (28–32%, small-caps grey labels) + wide right body + hairline rules, mandatory decimal numbering, dotted-leader TOC (legal) or hairline+two-tone-number TOC (narrative), em-dash '——' lead-ins, arrow bullets → / ↳. CO-BRAND: partner logos keep their OWN color while Palantir stays monochrome, joined in a 'Palantir • partner' slash/bullet lockup (per Airbus deck). Effects layer is deliberately near-empty: full-bleed looping product-reel video + alternating light/charcoal bands + one fade-up scroll-reveal + black↔white hover inversion; everything else plain CSS. particles / real-time 3D / shaders / canvas / cursor tricks / glassmorphism = enabled:false — inventing any violates the brand. DEGRADATION DIFF: the 写経 replica lost the real typeface (system -apple-system), invented a #00FF00 accent, and used generic Tailwind grays; the 多元 preview adds its own teal (#0F766E/#2DD4BF) + Public Sans — a legitimate 多元 choice but NOT Palantir DNA. This artifact is the canonical Palantir Design DNA restored from a full primary-source read.
